verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a dedicated Memory Export feature that produces structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas. The CLI can list memories, and the open-source self-hosted option means you own the data and stack, which together address portability and lock-in. Evidence is limited to short first-party doc snippets. missing for 10: confirmation of complete bulk export of the whole store (not just schema-shaped extracts), the concrete output format (e.g. JSON/file), an import/restore path into another system, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
